Light and modern 2 bedroom apartment. Suitable for both vacation and business trips.

The apartment has a living room with an open kitchen solution, a bathroom and two bedrooms. Free parking just outside the building.

The bus stop is about 50 meters from the apartment. Buses 20 and 24 go to the city center. Bus 24 also goes directly to and from the airport.

The apartment is fully equipped and is suitable for both short and longer stays. A convenient starting point for experiencing Tromsø all year.
